meta.name: mcp-developer
meta.description: Use when building, debugging, or extending MCP servers or clients that connect AI systems with external tools and data sources. Invoke to implement tool handlers, configure resource providers, set up stdio/HTTP/SSE transport layers, validate schemas with Zod or Pydantic, debug protocol compliance issues, or scaffold complete MCP server/client projects using TypeScript or Python SDKs.

copy.tagline: 构建、调试和扩展MCP服务器与客户端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发或调试连接AI与外部工具的MCP服务。
copy.tagline_en: Build, debug, and extend MCP servers and clients
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or debugging MCP services that connect AI with external tools.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你搭建、调试和扩展 MCP 服务器或客户端，让 AI 系统连接外部工具和数据源。它会生成代码、验证协议、处理错误。
howto.when: 当你需要构建或调试 MCP 服务器/客户端，比如实现工具处理、配置传输层（stdio/HTTP/SSE）或验证协议合规时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 TypeScript 创建一个 MCP 服务器，添加一个获取天气的工具。
say.note: Claude 会生成项目代码和 Zod 验证。

say.text: 用 Python 搭建一个 MCP 客户端，连接外部 API。
检查这个 MCP 服务器的协议合规性。
say.note: Claude 会运行 inspector 并分析结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you build, debug, and extend MCP servers or clients that connect AI systems with external tools and data sources. It generates code, validates protocols, and handles errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build or debug MCP servers/clients, such as implementing tool handlers, configuring transport layers (stdio/HTTP/SSE), or validating protocol compliance.

say_en.text: Create an MCP server in TypeScript with a weather tool.
say_en.note: Claude will generate project code with Zod validation.

say_en.text: Build an MCP client in Python to connect an external API.
say_en.note: Claude will use FastMCP and Pydantic to generate code.

say_en.text: Check protocol compliance of this MCP server.
say_en.note: Claude will run the inspector and analyze results.
